classification_disputes: Rule 2 (USDM stale if more than ~9.1 days) is labelled A-supported-general. The principle 'a missing or failed fetch is never no drought' is fine as A. The 9.1-day number is not published anywhere: it is the research's own derivation from the normal Tuesday-to-Thursday schedule. The cited USDM page says nothing about holidays, and the research admits holiday shifts are not modelled, so a holiday-delayed release would wrongly trip the stale flag. The numeric threshold should be B or C (configurable, with a holiday allowance), not A.

Rule 14 (breeding/calving scheduling) is labelled A-supported-general. Only the recording elements are A: record breeding start/end, preg status for every exposed female, and BCS at the three points. BIF says palpation 'After 35 days post breeding'. The rule's 'no earlier than 35 days after bull removal' is a derivation, and BIF gives earliest detectability for genetic-evaluation recording, not a recommended schedule; the research itself says 'the timing is a minimum, not an optimum'. The 'BCS 60-90 days before calving' prompt needs a calving date from an unsourced gestation length. When to schedule preg checks and BCS prompts is a ranch and veterinarian choice, so B or C.

Rule 7 (ARS breathing-rate heat outlook) is labelled B-context-dependent. Drovers says the maps were 'designed specifically for cattle feeders', and the equation's references (Brown-Brandl 2005; Eigenberg 2005) are feedlot-oriented. Applying them to pasture or range cattle is extrapolation. The trigger 'warn when a planned gather or move falls on a Danger or worse day' is a ranch management choice (C), not published guidance. B fits only the category display, not the warning rule.

Rule 11 (water days of supply) is labelled B. Only the intake-by-class-and-temperature input is sourced (NDSU AS1763 / NRC 2016). The formula itself (usable fraction, refill over the period, head at the tank) and the warning threshold are unsourced engineering or ranch choices. The rule as a whole should read as 'C rule using B inputs'. The research's configurable field partly says this, but the headline classification overstates it.

Rule 9 (CCI cold-stress prompt) has a minor evidence problem rather than a classification problem. The B label for the bands is fair, but the evidence says KFYR 'reports NDAWN promoting it'. The article quotes a 'livestock management specialist' (Lacey Quail) whose employer is not named, so it is not evidence of Extension or NDAWN endorsement.
summary:
I fetched all 51 unique URLs cited in the research with WebFetch. All were reachable. curl through the proxy was refused ('CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'), so every check relies on WebFetch's model-summarised page text, and quotes are as the summariser returned them. I also fetched two related URLs that are not in the citation list: the ArcGIS /query, whose epochs I converted with node to 2026-10-13T07:30Z and 2026-10-15T07:30Z (3:30 AM ET), and IEM geojson/usdm.py, which returned date 2026-10-13. Both confirm the research's observations.

Core numbers verified exactly:
- USDM schedule and wording: '8 a.m. EDT' cutoff on USDM versus '7 a.m. Eastern Time' on SD DANR and '7 am Eastern' / '7 a.m. EST' on drought.gov; Thursday 8:30 ET release.
- Hughes County rows: 20260929 at 68.45/31.55 and 20260922 at 91.73/8.27.
- LFP tiers: 4 consecutive weeks of D2 gives 1 payment; D3 at any time gives 3; D4 for 4 weeks gives 5.
- NASS reports: KS 5/10/29/46/10 and SD 24/29/31/15/1.
- ARS equation and categories: 2.83/0.58/-0.76/0.039/-196.4, T>80F, units F/%/mph/W/m2.
- NDAWN CCI bands: Adult Cold Moderate -4 to 13 F; Newborn Cold Moderate 23 to 31 F.
- NDSU AS1763 intakes: 11.4/16.9/17.9/16.2 and 12.7; bleach 2-3 oz per 50 gal, weekly.
- BIF timings: 35/27 days, 60-90 days pre-calving.
- Also confirmed: PRISM (8 updates, 6 months, twice in 24 h); SDA (POST-only, 100,000 rows); RAP (1986 to previous year; MAE 2.6-10.2%; TOS 2024-09-11); Grass-Cast (biweekly, 10 km, 38-year average, 'As of August 31, 2026', 60-80% stated without a metric).

Problems found, all in integration or data_field details rather than the core rules:
- **ARS heat maps:** 'Daily intent per press (2020)' is unsupported. Farm Progress gives no frequency and Drovers says 'weekly forecasts'.
- **NDAWN:** station counts (245/181/58/6 MT) are not on the cited CCI page, which shows only NDAWN and Minnesota maps.
- **SD Mesonet:** '5-minute updates' and the cost statements are not on the cited page.
- **Nebraska Mesonet:** the 'NSCO page says 63' has no URL. 'Request Data by contact' and 'Coming Soon' are not on the cited blog.
- **USDM web service:** 'thousands separators in area mode' is not on WebServiceInfo.
- **Grass-Cast Data:** the data.gov CC BY 4.0 claim is not on Data.aspx, and the annual grid file is XLSX, not CSV.
- **Data-field evidence URLs:** the crew_task field cites the NDMC Plan page, which says nothing about crew tasks. The tanks capacity/refill field cites NDSU, which covers intake only.
- **KFYR:** the article does not name the specialist's employer, and NDAWN itself is not quoted.
- **Metadata:** the rnassqs vignette is dated 2026-09-29 (v0.6.4), not undated. Grass-Cast and PRISM documentation pages are mislabelled 'field-study'.
- **Minor wording:** the RAP quote 'Valid years run from...' is actually 'Valid years are 1986 through the previous year' (same meaning).
- **Map attribution:** 'Map courtesy of NDMC' is map-only guidance, extended by the research to data rows.
- **ACIS:** the docs page rendered empty, so nothing there is verifiable.
- **NASS release time:** the 4:00 pm ET release time comes from a 2007 document and was not confirmed by a current source.

Classification disputes: rule 2's 9.1-day threshold (A is too generous because the number is derived and breaks on holiday weeks), rule 14 (A applies to the recording elements only; the scheduling lead times are ranch or veterinarian choices), rule 7 (feedlot-designed model; the move warning is a C choice), and rule 11 (C rule using B inputs). Rules 1, 8 and 18 at A are adequately supported by explicit publisher statements.

No repo files were modified. I created only the scratch folder /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude-ranch-ops-dashboard/c61c6ab5-2745-59d3-9dda-44a2053cd423/scratchpad/audit/cite-context/dl, which is empty because the curl downloads were blocked.
